content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The rule is where S5-bracket's protocol (otmxqplr), G-marker's record shape (kkqzyxly), D8a's inverse (prsoxsuo), S5-lifecycle's bracketing (vwlrqoxk) and S5-birth-fail's abandoned birth (kvwonkzy) meet: it decides which of the brackets those fix become a record, so it must not re-decide any of them — a marker holds a change (G-marker), undo needs a change it can remove (D8a), the bracketed invocations are the lifecycle's, and the refused birth has already rolled back (S5-birth-fail). Prose to prose across all five edges, with no artifact performing the check, so the criterion is the License form; the mixed cells stay flagged for the matrix.
